title: Case J — 1:1:2 building, non-isothermal
summary: Isolated 1:1:2 building with a floor tracer source in an unstably stratified boundary layer: velocity, temperature, tracer concentration and their turbulent fluxes at 444 points on three planes.

configuration.building: 1:1:2 (width : depth : height) prism, b = 0.08 m, H = 2b = 0.16 m
configuration.stratification: unstable: heated floor 45.8 degC, air at z = H 12.2 degC (difference 33.6 K), bulk Richardson number -0.086; building surface 22.0 .. 28.9 degC (mean 24.5 degC, 121 points in clean/cases/J/surface_temperature.csv)
configuration.source: 5 mm floor outlet at (0.04, 0, 0), 0.25 H beyond the leeward wall; 5 % ethylene in air at 30.4 degC, 9.17e-6 m3/s
configuration.concentration_normalisation: c0 = 0.05 q / (U_H H^2) = 12.283 ppm (the workbook's value; the 5 % gas fraction is in it)
configuration.instrument: split-fibre hot wire (velocity), cold wire (temperature), high-speed hydrocarbon analyser (concentration), 1000 Hz, 120 s per point
configuration.tunnel: thermally stratified wind tunnel, Tokyo Polytechnic University (Atsugi); 1.2 m wide, 1.0 m high
configuration.scale_note: model scale; the sources state no model:full scale ratio

units.temperature: degC (T); K (T_rms); heat fluxes K m/s

frame.origin: the building's leeward (downwind) wall centre on the ground; x = 0 is the leeward wall
frame.x: +x streamwise (the wind blows toward +x); the building spans x in [-0.08, 0]; the floor source is at x = +0.04
frame.y: +y lateral; the building spans y in [-0.04, 0.04]; the z/H = 0.025 plane is measured on the y <= 0 side only
frame.z: +z up; roof at z = 0.16; heated floor at z = 0

inflow_fit.method: least squares, kappa = 0.41, z = 0.02 .. 2H on AF_caseJ.csv
inflow_fit.note: derived during scoping, not published by AIJ; the boundary layer is unstably stratified, so a neutral log law is only a rough description

fit.method: least squares, kappa = 0.41, z = 0.02 .. 2H on AF_caseJ.csv
fit.note: derived during scoping, not published by AIJ; the boundary layer is unstably stratified, so a neutral log law is only a rough description

benchmark_data.note: the measured profile and the fit of it are the benchmark's data as cleaned here; everything under `recommended` is a choice

recommended.status: RECOMMENDED by this repository (not part of the benchmark): a log-law inlet fitted to the case's own approach-flow file, with k and epsilon from the standard neutral ABL relations. Any inlet may be submitted; say which in submission.yaml
recommended.profile: U(z) = u*/kappa ln((z + z0)/z0); k = u*^2 / sqrt(Cmu); epsilon = u*^3 / (kappa (z + z0))
recommended.fit: least squares, kappa = 0.41, z = 0.02 .. 2H on AF_caseJ.csv
recommended.openfoam: atmBoundaryLayerInletVelocity / atmBoundaryLayerInletK / atmBoundaryLayerInletEpsilon with Uref, Zref, z0 and d = 0; nutkAtmRoughWallFunction with the same z0 on the ground: cases/{id}/inflow_openfoam.txt holds them

flow_direction.meaning: +x is along the wind at WD = 0: flowDir (1 0 0); another WD rotates it about +z by the case's rotation sense (frame.wind_direction_rotation)

inflow.domain: the extents, blockage and cell sizes of Eddy3D's domains are not in its snapshots and are not stated here; mesh.cells and the scale are, where the snapshot has them

probes.columns_meaning: the key columns of a scored file (point_id with config, campaign, instrument, run and wind_direction_deg as the case has them), x, y, z in m (case frame), and scored_as: the families the row is scored in (vector, k, thermistor_bracket, concentration, theta, joined by +)

scoring.U_ref_meaning: U_H, the approach speed at the building height (the tunnel's units)

theta.meaning: T_floor = 318.95 K, T_H = 285.32 K (the approach air at the building height)

scored_as.vector: U, V, W and the speed |U| against the split-fibre, LDV or hot-wire components (velocity.U, velocity.V, velocity.W, speed)
scored_as.thermistor_bracket: a mean scalar speed (thermistor, cup or sonic anemometer) against |U| (vs.vector) and sqrt(|U|^2 + 2k) (vs.scalar)

scoring.conventions: velocities and the speed over U_ref, k over U_ref^2 (Cases E, F and G publish ratios already); U, V, W, |U| and the thermistor bracket scored as signed velocities (FAC2's ratio keeps the sign; hit rate D = 0.25, W = 0.05); k by the plain definitions (D = 0.25 only); a thermistor, cup or sonic reading (a mean scalar speed) scored against |U| (vs.vector) and sqrt(|U|^2 + 2k) (vs.scalar), the two ends of its bracket; c* = C/c0 with one detection limit per case, 1e-3 of the largest measured value; theta = (T_floor - T)/(T_floor - T_H) scored like a positive velocity. The same conventions score the served Eddy3D results (docs/validation/method.md).
scoring.tool: python validation/score_submissions.py <folder>, from a checkout of the repository (requirements.txt)

metric_meaning.MeanObserved: mean of the measured, normalised quantity
metric_meaning.MeanPredicted: mean of the modelled, normalised quantity
metric_meaning.Fb: fractional bias, 2 (mean_obs - mean_pred) / (mean_obs + mean_pred); positive = model low
metric_meaning.Fac2: fraction of points within a factor of two (harsh near zero for sign-changing V and W)
metric_meaning.HitRate: fraction of points within D = 0.25 relative or W = 0.05 U_H absolute
metric_meaning.GeometricPairs: pairs with both values positive (used for Mg/Vg)
metric_meaning.null: a metric that is undefined for the data (for example Mg and Vg when no pair has both values positive; Fb, Nmse and Nad of a signed velocity component of Case H or I whose observed and predicted means are not both positive)

known_issues: Temperature is in KELVIN in all three published CSVs; the API serves degrees Celsius (T) and kelvin differences (T_rms, heat fluxes).

The published CSV is the legacy workbook's non-dimensional values rounded to 3-4 decimals and scaled back; the table is rebuilt from the workbook. The CSV's heat fluxes sit on a 0.0049 K m/s grid and k on 0.00021 m^2/s^2.
c0 = 12.283 ppm includes the 5 % ethylene fraction of the released gas (workbook cell Co); q / (U_H H^2) alone is 245.7 ppm. The data paper states no c0 for Case J.
RS_caseJ.csv lists the location (-0.16, 0, 0.004) twice (No. 1 and 153, identical values): a score over the table counts that point twice.
The workbook's <u'2> is not always the square of its sigma_u (up to 3 % in single rows); the table uses the variances, which reproduce k.

The workbook lists an expanded uncertainty beside every quantity (no column here; clean/manifest.json cases.J.extra_measurements.expanded_uncertainty). The mean concentration is below its own uncertainty (about 1 ppm) at 42 % of the rows, and 193 uncertainty cells of the w'theta' flux are an Excel fill series, not values.

The empty-tunnel profile changes along the tunnel: U at z = 0.019 H is 0.33 U_H at x/H = -2.5 (the published AF_caseJ.csv), 0.58 at the building's own position. The workbook has all three stations (clean/cases/J/approach_flow_full.csv).

The +y and -y halves are not mirror images: over the 97 mirror pairs of the z/H = 0.25 plane U at +y is 11 % lower (means 0.558 and 0.629 U_H, R between the halves 0.955), so a y-symmetric model has a ceiling on this file.
The readme's Reynolds number (43,000) is Case H's; U_H H / nu = 1.6e4 as the data paper states.
uv, uw, vw are not published at the points; uc, vc, wc were not measured.
